title: Towards a wide bandgap absorber: structural, morphological, and optical investigation of Ag-alloyed Cu2ZnSnS4 thin films
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01303H, Paper

Messaoud Tamin, Outman El Khouja, Mohamed Guemmaz, Charif Tamin, Amelia Elena Bocirnea, Ilhame Asshsahi, Denis Chaumont, Aurelian Catalin Galca
Controlled synthesis of Ag-alloyed Cu2ZnSnS4 (ACZTS) thin films with wide range of Ag/Cu ratios via a solution process enables phase transition, lattice expansion, and bandgap tuning, yielding stable absorbers for next-generation photovoltaics.
